skills.name: Force Assault
lines: Fire type piercing attack on a single enemy
* Fire type piercing attack on all enemies (XL)
* Power and Speed of user +50% (3 turns, max stack x3: +100%)
* Stacks 1 Photon Acceleration on user
* Stacks 2 when attack on single enemy is critical
* Added effect from number of Photon Accelerations:
** 1+: Restore all party members MP 15% and Max HP of all party members +1000 (3 turns)
** 2: Critical rate of user +100% (3 moves) and Critical Damage of user +50% (3 turns)
* Photon Acceleration: Physical Resistance +7.5% per stack (max stack x2: +15%)

skills.name: Blast Drive
lines: Fire type blunt attack on all enemies (XL)
* Effects and skill multiplier are based on number of Photon Acceleration stacked 0 > 1 > 2
** Skill multiplier 160% > 240% > 520%
** Physical resistance of all main and reserve party members +20% (3 turns) > +25% (4 turns) > +30% (5 turns)
** Type attack of user +30% (1 move) > +35% (2 moves) > +40% (3 moves)
* Upon usage of skill, all Photon Acceleration stacks are consumed.
